texts.li: {X_nameDef} asked {A_nameDef} whether this was the colony that helped {FACTION} folk when they had nowhere else to turn. When {A_nameDef} said it was, {X_nameDef} shook {A_possessive} hand for a long time and didn't let go.
{X_nameDef} told {A_nameDef} that a cousin of {X_possessive} owes this colony a life, and that the whole family knows the colony's name because of it.
Over supper {X_nameDef} told the table, and {A_nameDef} in particular, what {FACTION} say about this place: that it took in their people when it didn't have to.
{X_nameDef} knocked a good part off the price before {A_nameDef} had even started to haggle. "{FACTION} remember their friends," {X_pronoun} said, and wouldn't hear another word about it.
{X_nameDef} set aside the best of the goods for {A_nameDef} and threw in a little extra, for what the colony once did for {FACTION}.
{A_nameDef} went to haggle with {X_nameDef} and found there was nothing to haggle over: the price was already fair, and then some.
{X_nameDef} served {A_nameDef} last, after everyone else, and named a price twice what it should have been. "{FACTION} have long memories," was all {X_pronoun} said.
{X_nameDef} wouldn't haggle with {A_nameDef} at all, and put the goods away the moment {A_nameDef} said where {A_pronoun} was from.
{A_nameDef} spent an afternoon talking {X_nameDef} round to an ordinary price. It took everything {A_pronoun} had. {FACTION} haven't forgotten what this colony did.
{X_nameDef} wouldn't sit at the same table as {A_nameDef} and took {X_possessive} supper outside. Something about what this colony did to {FACTION}, someone said.
{A_nameDef} offered {X_nameDef} a cup of water at the gate. {X_nameDef} looked at it, then at {A_nameDef}, and walked past.
{X_nameDef} asked {A_nameDef}, quite politely, whether the colony still does the kind of thing it did to {FACTION}. {A_nameDef} didn't know what to answer.
{X_nameDef} mentioned, lightly, that {FACTION} once helped this colony when it needed it, and wondered aloud whether anyone here remembered.
{X_nameDef} told {A_nameDef} that {FACTION} don't keep accounts of what they give their neighbours, and then told {A_objective} exactly what they had given this colony.
